content: A comprehensive review of the current market landscape indicates that many prominent firms provide generalized mining consulting or broader engineering insights rather than explicitly delineating their safety-related service portfolios. For instance, international entities such as Globe24-7 maintain a significant presence in the mining industry, but their primary focus remains concentrated on talent acquisition and leadership consulting, with their specialization not extending directly into mining safety consulting specific to the South African context [1] .
